title: Glenny, Picou and playing with Celestin
summary: Mention of older players such as Glenny and Picou; her father played second trumpet with Celestin.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: 52 years old. Some people keep on playing until they're old. Sure. Old man Glennie did I guess. Until he was in his 80's he could still play. Yeah.
Piku still plays. Yes, that's right. He's over 80.
That's another man my father used to play with. He knows my daddy well.
Yes, I think he's mentioned him when we talked to him. I'm quite sure he talked to him.
And you know who my daddy used to play with? A lot. Celestine.
Yeah. Played a lot with him. In other words, I don't know whether they, who was the leader. But I know they played, didn't he play a trumpet?
Oh yes, he played trumpet too.
If I can remember correctly, my father used to tell me that he played the second.
Yes, I usually used two trumpets in his back.
He was first and Celestine was second.
There's another one. Every now and then something comes back.
